source: rvt-py 2.2.3, rvt.default.DefaultValues.__init__; Apache-2.0. RVT defaults are in DEM pixels unless labelled metres. See RVT_LIDAR.md.

hillshade.label: Hillshade
hillshade.description: One-direction sun lighting; features parallel to light may be hidden.

multi-hillshade.label: Multi-hillshade (multi-directional)
multi-hillshade.description: Combines many illumination directions to reduce directional blind spots.

slope.label: Slope
slope.description: Terrain steepness in degrees, independent of lighting.

slrm.label: Simple local relief model
slrm.description: Height minus the local terrain trend within the smoothing radius.

msrm.label: Multi-scale relief model
msrm.description: Highlights small ground features across a range of sizes by subtracting broad landscape trends.

mstp.label: Multi-scale topographic position
mstp.unavailable: RVT default broad radius is 2023 DEM pixels; requires an offline precomputed RGB pyramid.
mstp.description: Three-scale topographic position shown in colour. Requires offline processing.

svf.label: Sky-view
svf.description: Visible proportion of the sky from each ground point.

local-dominance.label: Local dominance
local-dominance.description: Local prominence seen from an observer just above the terrain.

sky-illumination.label: Sky illumination
sky-illumination.description: Diffuse illumination from the sky dome.

vat.label: VAT
vat.unavailable: Requires a separately validated RVT blending recipe and RGB float output.

combined-vat.label: Combined VAT
combined-vat.unavailable: Requires a separately validated RVT blending recipe and RGB float output.

prismatic-openness.label: Prismatic openness
prismatic-openness.unavailable: Requires a separately validated RVT blending recipe and RGB float output.

openness.label: Openness
openness.description: Positive highlights ridges; negative highlights hollows. Calculated from the DTM.

crim.label: CRIM
crim.unavailable: No verified RVT recipe or RGB float pyramid; unavailable rather than faking this filter.

e2mstp.label: e²MSTP
e2mstp.unavailable: No verified RVT recipe or RGB float pyramid; unavailable rather than faking this filter.

e3mstp.label: e³MSTP
e3mstp.unavailable: No verified RVT recipe or RGB float pyramid; unavailable rather than faking this filter.
